prompt:
Convert these API notes into HTML documentation:

---
Create Post

POST /posts

Creates a new post in the system.

Response on success (201):
{
  "id": "post_789",
  "title": "My First Post",
  "body": "This is the content.",
  "created_at": "2024-01-20T14:22:00Z"
}
---

assertions.name: html-valid-structure
assertions.description: Output contains valid HTML5 structure with DOCTYPE, html, head, and body tags

assertions.name: api-title-present
assertions.description: API name 'Create Post' is present in the HTML (in title tag or h1)

assertions.name: endpoint-method-present
assertions.description: HTTP method 'POST' and endpoint '/posts' are present

assertions.name: description-section-present
assertions.description: Description section exists with text 'Creates a new post in the system'

assertions.name: success-response-present
assertions.description: Success Response section is present with status code 201 and response JSON structure

assertions.name: no-authentication-section
assertions.description: Authentication section is NOT present (because source notes do not mention authentication)

assertions.name: no-parameters-section
assertions.description: Request Parameters section is NOT present (because source notes do not describe parameters)

assertions.name: no-error-section
assertions.description: Error Responses section is NOT present (because source notes do not describe error responses)

assertions.name: no-invented-sections
assertions.description: No placeholder or invented sections for missing data. Only sections mentioned in source are included.

assertions.name: semantic-html
assertions.description: Uses semantic HTML5 structure with proper heading hierarchy and code formatting
